H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H974: to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate
H5254: to test; by implication, to attempt
H6884: to fuse (metal), i.e. refine (literally or figuratively)
H3629: a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H5048: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H4962: properly, an adult (as of full length); by implication, a man (only in the plural)

H5956: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal (literally or figuratively)
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H7489: properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good fornothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally)
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H7364: to lave (the whole or a part of a thing)
H3709: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
H5437: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)

H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H6381: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H4583: an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum)
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H4725: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
H4908: a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls)
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H622: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)
H2400: a criminal, or one accounted guilty
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H1818: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H2154: a plan, especially a bad one
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H6299: to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H7272: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H4334: a level, i.e. a plain (often used (with the article prefix) as a proper name of certain districts); figuratively, concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) justice (sometimes adverbially, justly)
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
